Kaiser, M.J. (2017). A review of refinery complexity applications. Petroleum Science, 14(1), 167-194. https://doi.org/10.1007/s12182-016-0137-y

Loaded: capital cost per bpd of refinery process units from (i) six USGC grassroots projects 2010-2012 (Table 4, reprinted from Industrial Information 2014), (ii) the Jieyang China coking refinery estimate (Table 11; only the FCC is a reported cost, other units are complexity-factor estimates), (iii) 2009 USGC cost functions applied to the Toledo refinery (Table 17, reprinted from Kaiser and Gary 2009), plus two whole-refinery costs per bpd (Toledo replacement cost new; Jieyang reported cost). Not loaded: complexity factors and indices (other-values, as instructed: they are cost ratios, not energy parameters), sales-price statistics (other-values). The paper has no energy use, emissions or operating-cost figures per unit. Price years: Table 4 not stated (2012 used); Table 11 from table title 2014; Table 17 2009 (cost functions) and 2011 (indexed). Cost scope (ISBL vs off-sites) not stated except Table 17 (on-sites; off-sites 30% added at plant level). Locator: printed journal page numbers (PDF page = printed - 166). Distinct technology names (reactor_hydrocracking-vgo, reactor_hydrotreating-diesel etc.) all map to reactor_hydroprocessing.
